module_tone: Warm market fantasy with a thread of mystery

starting_location.name: Lantern Market Gate
starting_location.description: A covered market gate where travelers can meet the lantern keeper.
starting_location.entry_hook: A missing shipment has made the market unusually quiet.

areas.name: Lantern Market
areas.purpose: A playable shop district for investigation, trade, and small complications.

location_seeds.name: Lantern Market Gate
location_seeds.purpose: Introduce the market and the missing shipment.
location_seeds.description: A crowded gate opens onto stalls of glass, brass, and colored flame.

location_seeds.name: Lanternwright Stall
location_seeds.purpose: Offer item choices and reveal the source of the trouble.
location_seeds.description: A narrow stall displays safe travel lights and one sealed black lantern.

plot_objective.summary: Find the missing shipment before the market closes for the night.
plot_objective.success_condition: The party recovers the shipment or establishes a safe replacement route.
plot_objective.failure_condition: The market loses trust and the shipment reaches a dangerous buyer.

plot_progression.name: Ask at the gate
plot_progression.description: The keeper points the party toward the lanternwright stall.
plot_progression.objective: Learn who last handled the shipment.

plot_progression.name: Trace the black lantern
plot_progression.description: The party follows clues through the market and chooses how to intervene.
plot_progression.objective: Recover the shipment without harming the market community.
plot_progression.resolution: A successful resolution opens a future trade or investigation hook.

npc_seeds.name: Mira Vell
npc_seeds.purpose: Provide the opening request and a cautious ally.
npc_seeds.source_basis: Merchant role retained from the source concept

encounter_seeds.name: The Sealed Lantern
encounter_seeds.setup: A hidden buyer tries to remove the black lantern during the market rush.
encounter_seeds.stakes: The shipment and the safety of nearby customers are at risk.
resolution_paths: Negotiate a surrender and learn who placed the order.
Chase the buyer through the market without destroying the stalls.
encounter_seeds.source_basis: Adapted from the source catalogue complication

item_seeds.name: Wayfinder Lantern
item_seeds.purpose: Give the party a useful travel tool and a reason to return.
item_seeds.description: A hooded lantern whose colored flame reveals safe paths through fog.
item_seeds.source_basis: Adapted from the catalogue item family

puzzle_or_trial_seeds.name: Three Flame Seal
puzzle_or_trial_seeds.premise: The black lantern opens only when three harmless flames are arranged by color.
puzzle_or_trial_seeds.resolution_guidance: Use observation, experimentation, or a helpful market witness.
puzzle_or_trial_seeds.failure_consequence: The seal dims and delays the party without dealing automatic damage.

retained_source_elements.element: A catalogue of lanterns and travel lights
retained_source_elements.reason: Retained as the market's item identity and visual theme.

omitted_source_elements.element: Long item-only listings without play hooks
omitted_source_elements.reason: Omitted from rooms and plot beats because they do not add playable action.

original_adaptation_elements.element: Lantern Market Gate and its missing-shipment hook
original_adaptation_elements.reason: Creates a playable entry point for a catalogue-shaped source.

world_narrative_hooks.hook: The black lantern may be part of a wider signal network.
world_narrative_hooks.relationship: Candidate thread for a later travel or smuggling module.
world_narrative_hooks.proposed_follow_up: Let a future approved world seed decide whether the signal returns.

continuity_hints.hint: Mira Vell can recognize the party if they return with the shipment.

rights_basis: Operator attested that the uploaded source is user-authored.
assumptions: The catalogue permits a shop-centered playable adaptation.
Generic fantasy framing is acceptable for the NEQ-TTRPG setting.
warnings: The adapted module is not a literal source-fidelity reproduction.
